protocol.name: BBBC001v1: repaired full harness versus vanilla Astra
protocol.working_tree: New comparison config only; inference runtime matches the recorded commit.
protocol.selection: All six published images, in annotation-file order; no exclusions.
protocol.split_note: BBBC001 has no official train/test split. 'test' is a local Harbor routing label only.
protocol.task: Published cell-counting task; identical neutral instruction for every image and mode.
protocol.primary_metric: Mean over all six images of 100 * abs(prediction - mean(two human counts)) / mean(two human counts); lower is better.
protocol.missing_policy: No official full-dataset score if any prediction is missing, negative, nonfinite or an error. Show coverage and answered-subset error separately; do not rank partial scores against complete scores.
protocol.preprocessing: Lossless 8-bit grayscale TIFF to RGB PNG by channel replication. No resize, contrast adjustment, denoising, annotation overlays or synthetic pixels.
protocol.leakage: Only PNG and question enter the agent environment; counts, original filenames, source URLs and dataset metadata stay in verifier/report. Prior model exposure to this public dataset cannot be ruled out.
limitations: Only six images from one experiment, not broad multimodal evidence.
Published human counts disagree; their mean is the reference, not an exact biological truth.
Current OpenCV tools are color/white-background tools, not microscopy segmentation models.
Independent plans and different compute per mode prevent a clean causal estimate of Jev selection alone.
No changes during this run; one attempt per image/mode, with the configured bounded per-call format retry.
This is a retest of previously inspected benchmark images after integration fixes.
Incomplete modes receive a completion rate and answered-subset error, not a fabricated full-benchmark error.
protocol.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; images and ground truth by David Root and Anne Carpenter.
protocol.attribution: BBBC001v1, Moffat et al. (Cell, 2006), Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection; Ljosa et al. (Nature Methods, 2012).
protocol.user_scope: Full harness retains Jev methodology scoring AND answer review. Skip the separate review-only ablation.
protocol.prior_exposure: Same six benchmark images were used in the previous experiment and provider-recovery debugging. This is a retest after integration fixes, not a fresh held-out evaluation.
